user.title: New school

semaine.title: {nom}'s week

data_description.moselle: Adds Good Friday and St Stephen's Day.

init.title: Week and extra days off

error.invalid_days_off: Date not understood: use YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY, and ".." for a range.
